changes.acceptance: Start the v0.2 client against the v0.1 server. Connect to a private home, inspect Weather, refresh and reconnect to its README, then return with focus restored. Verify app and folder widgets, Target Cursor, Settings previews, loading, empty and recovery states through the release launcher. Use one active profile and the recorded defaults: System theme, Glass surface, Comfortable density, motion on and Target cursor. Under the same Windows login, save different settings for two members, restart the client on a different port and verify that each member recovers their own settings. Close the six Sprint-6 follow-up items on PR #9, including live prototype replay and independent browser acceptance of the final candidate.
changes.evidence: All 21 items are in review with evidence; both independent QA reports pass after retest with zero Sev-1; the combined candidate ran the release journey through the real launcher; CI covers the Edge tools, Scrum store, v0.1 server, client tests, build, host, launcher and fixtures. PR #9 is open against codex/development-workspace for owner review and merge. Assumptions are in scrumWorkspace/documents/PI-02/assumptions.md. This is historical evidence for the original five sprints. The owner requested a sixth sprint for four fixes, live prototype replay and independent browser QA. Final acceptance evidence is pending.
